_comment: M28.11 add_function_output post-apply soak. Duplicates BP_BpxTestGraphNodesCalls into a scratch path and appends a bool output parameter `bSuccess` to DoTheThing's K2Node_FunctionResult::UserDefinedPins. The base fixture's DoTheThing is a void/void function; AddFunctionGraph<UClass> with nullptr signature spawns an Entry node but may not always materialize a Result node — the bridge auto-spawns Result with a deterministic NodeGuid + pin IDs (seeded from <bp>:func:DoTheThing:result) when missing. Soak asserts md5 stability across 2 rounds, covering both the auto-spawn-then-pin-add path AND the pin-add-on-existing-Result path (round 1 spawns Result; round 2 hits idempotence skip).
